mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the cases when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the cases when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the cases when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the cases when INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) suggests a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the cases when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the cases when HOUST increases > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) suggests stagflation, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the cases when GDPC1 decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
